decisions.reason: The gas tariff comparison runs on existing market-data databases at low maintenance cost and is publicly presented on its own page, so management stays committed to it.
The electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent and has its own page, and it feeds the central platform the firm has announced, so withdrawing it would contradict the firm's stated direction.
The multi-model line represents substantial sunk investment, and weak results can still be blamed on platform integration being incomplete, although its low visibility leaves room for consolidation.
The area definition tool underpins the remaining location-based products and is visibly featured, so it stays even after the margin analysis was withdrawn.
Although it overlaps with other tariff tools and is only modestly visible, the several models already built and the close fit with the core business justify keeping the line.
